name: replaceNoCase
description:
Replaces occurrences of substring1 with substring2, in the
specified scope. The search is case-insensitive.
syntax: replaceNoCase( string string, any substring, [string replacement], [string scope] )

params.name: string
params.description: A string (or variable that contains one) within which to replace substring.

params.name: substring
params.description:
Substring for which to search.

Optionally pass a Struct with key/value pairs to do a replace all

params.name: replacement
params.description:
Substring with which to replace the found matches.

This arg is required if the substring1 arg is a string

params.name: scope
params.description:
scope for the execution:

- one (default): Replace the first occurrence
- all: Replace all occurrences
